The loader --list check proves immediate dependencies resolve. Runtime dynamically loaded profiling components still require the actual CUPTI initialization/result logs.
CLOCK_MONOTONIC phase timing and CUPTI timestamps are different clocks; compare durations or explicit calibrated correlation, never subtract unaligned clocks.
